lines.text: Want first person in GTA 6? There's no full mode, but there is a hidden view.
Rockstar confirmed there's no first-person mode at launch.
But stand still, hold L2, and click the right stick. On Xbox, that's LT and the right stick.
Move and it snaps back. And don't click both sticks without L2, or you'll trigger Focus mode.
Would you play the whole game in first person? Follow for more GTA 6 tips.
